Incentive for Excellent Performance While no explicit monetary incentive is provided, the following benefits shall be available to the SP for consistently excellent performance: • Certificate of Satisfactory Service upon successful completion of contract period • Eligibility for one-time contract extension of one additional year (Clause 5B of GTT) • Positive reference for future tenders from AIESL Ongoing Monthly Reporting Requirements · The Service Provider shall submit the following reports to the designated AIESL official by the 5th of every succeeding month: · Attendance Register (month-wise) for all deployed personnel with daily attendance · PF/ESI remittance challan copies (previous month)

· Minimum Wages compliance declaration (signed by SP's authorized representative) · Monthly deep cleaning completion checklist (duly signed by SP Supervisor and AIESL represent ative) · Chemical consumption report (type-wise quantity used) · Waste disposal records (trip sheets / weighment slips) · FOD Prevention Log for the month · Complaint Register extract (all complaints received and status) · Equipment maintenance log (for major equipment) · Pest control treatment records (if applicable in the month) Inspection & Quality Audit AIESL shall conduct monthly quality audits using checklist. Additionally : · AIESL reserves the right to conduct surprise inspections at any time without prior notice. · The SP's Supervisor shall be available to accompany AIESL inspectors during all inspections. · Corrective Action Required (CAR) notices shall be issued in writing for deficiencies observed. · SP shall respond to CAR within 24 hours with corrective action taken. · AIESL may engage third-party inspection agencies for quality audit at its own cost. Wage Revision Clause · Any increase in statutory minimum wages, PF/ESI rates, or other government-mandated levies du ring the contract period shall be reimbursed by AIESL upon production of documentary evidence. · Any decrease in such rates shall be passed on to AIESL proportionately. · Reimbursement/recovery shall be limited strictly to the statutory variation amount only. Internal SP decisions on commercial wage increases shall not be reimbursed. · SP shall notify AIESL within 15 days of any statutory revision with supporting documents. 6.
